title: VERTICO ─ IX. Signatures of environmental processing of the gas in Virgo cluster spiral galaxies through mapping of CO isotopologues
question: How do 13CO and C18O emission and line ratios in Virgo cluster spirals vary with galaxy properties, and what do they imply about environmental processing of the molecular gas?

data.arrays: ACA (7-m) plus Total Power for the most extended 25 of 36 new targets

what.value: VERTICO 12CO moment maps, mean gas and SFR surface densities and other galaxy properties

evidence.quote: These galaxy properties are taken directly from the other VERTICO papers
where the deficiencies are taken from (cite: Yoon2017) and (cite: 2012MNRAS.422.1835S)
using the tail angles derived in (cite: 2022MNRAS.517.2912L)

what.value: Comparison samples: EMPIRE field spirals and ATLAS3D ETGs line ratios

evidence.quote: field spirals from EMPIRE, and field and Virgo cluster ETGs from the ATLAS$^{\rm 3D}$ survey (cite: 2019ApJ...880..127J; 2015MNRAS.450.3874A)

recipe.goal: Make masked moment maps and directly detect isotopologues
recipe.method: Moment maps from native cubes with Sun2018 masks; check 13CO and C18O at 5 sigma
Shift spectra of every 12CO-detected spaxel by 12CO moment-1 velocity and co-add

recipe.goal: Fit stacked lines and estimate uncertainties
recipe.method: Single vs double gaussian (same centre) fitted with MCMC; double only if BIC lower; flux by integrating model; errors from 1000 random off-line window sums
Stack in concentric elliptical beam-width apertures, and in quadrants toward/away from HI tails

recipe.goal: Correlate line ratios with galaxy properties
recipe.method: Spearman rank, LTSFIT linear fit against mean gas surface density, k-sample Anderson-Darling tests across environment/morphology/HI-deficiency groups

answer_key.quantity: Spearman correlation 12CO/13CO vs mean molecular gas surface density

evidence.quote: Spearmans rank correlation coefficient (for the detected galaxies) of $\rho=-0.56$, and a $p$-value of 0.002

answer_key.quantity: Best-fit slope of 12CO/13CO vs log Sigma_mol
Spearman correlation with SFR surface density

evidence.quote: C$^{18}$O, on the other hand, was detected in 9 galaxies.

not_stated_but_needed: Calibration pipeline/CASA versions and imaging parameters (robust, channel width) for VERTICO cubes
GAStimator priors, initial guesses, chain length
Radial aperture count and widths, and S/N criteria for radial bin detections
Conversion of Jy km/s to K km/s used for ratios
Definition of detection threshold in stacks beyond 5 sigma
Stack-based quadrant wedge angles for tails
score_reason: Public data and code, but fitting settings, radial analysis details and upstream cubes depend on other papers.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, public stacking code, numeric tables of fluxes and ratios exist, though some settings unstated.
